nodes.name: model.cpp
nodes.summary: Model3D loader and runtime: OBJ/FBX import, GPU/CPU skinning, clip baking, and D3D11 draw with material and shadow binds.
nodes.languageNotes: Non-copyable because it owns D3D and FBX pointers; animation instances are cloned via CreateAnimInstanceFrom.

nodes.name: model.h
nodes.summary: Declares Model3D, the engine's GPU mesh/animation object with FBX bones, clip playback, and per-draw material overrides.

nodes.name: model_util.h
nodes.summary: Shared mesh/texture utilities for OBJ/FBX import: path helpers, WIC texture load, and vertex-key hashing used by Model3D.

nodes.name: render_settings.cpp
nodes.summary: Loads and applies scene render settings (skybox, fog, default shader, shadow quality) and rebuilds shadow maps when quality changes.

nodes.name: render_settings.h
nodes.summary: Scene-wide render settings data and accessors for skybox, fog, default shader variant, and shadow-quality presets.

nodes.name: Model3D
nodes.summary: Constructs an empty Model3D with no GPU buffers until LoadOBJ/LoadFBX.

nodes.name: ~Model3D
nodes.summary: Destructor that releases D3D and FBX resources owned by the model.

nodes.name: Release
nodes.summary: Releases vertex/index buffers, textures, FBX scene, and baked animation data.

nodes.name: LoadOBJ
nodes.summary: Imports an OBJ mesh and optional MTL textures into CPU vertices and D3D buffers.

nodes.name: LoadFBX
nodes.summary: Imports an FBX mesh, materials, bones, and base animation using the FBX SDK.

nodes.name: TryGetBoneLocalMatrix
nodes.summary: Looks up a bone's current model-space matrix for attachments or scripts.

nodes.name: ScaleBoneAndChildren
nodes.summary: Scales an FBX bone node and its children, used for editor/runtime bone tweaks.

nodes.name: SetPosition
nodes.summary: Sets the model's world translation used on the next Draw.

nodes.name: SetRotateEulerDeg
nodes.summary: Sets Euler-degree rotation applied when drawing the model.

nodes.name: SetScale
nodes.summary: Sets the model's world scale.

nodes.name: ApplyMaterialOverride
nodes.summary: Copies per-instance material override fields onto a GPU material.

nodes.name: BindNormalMapSlot
nodes.summary: Binds a normal-map SRV for the upcoming draw.

nodes.name: UnbindNormalMapSlot
nodes.summary: Clears the normal-map shader slot.

nodes.name: BindRampSlot
nodes.summary: Binds a toon-ramp texture SRV.

nodes.name: UnbindRampSlot
nodes.summary: Clears the toon-ramp shader slot.

nodes.name: InitMaterialDefaults
nodes.summary: Fills default albedo, specular, and emission for a newly imported material.

nodes.name: Draw
nodes.summary: Issues D3D11 draw calls for all submeshes with the current world transform and skin palette.

nodes.name: ApplyGeoPosition
nodes.summary: Writes a translation onto an FBX geometry node during import.

nodes.name: FbxToXM
nodes.summary: Converts an FbxAMatrix to an XMMATRIX.

nodes.name: CanGpuSkin
nodes.summary: True when bone weights and a skin palette are ready for GPU skinning.

nodes.name: RecreateVertexBufferFromCPU
nodes.summary: Rebuilds the D3D vertex buffer from CPU vertex data after a CPU-skin update.

nodes.name: BakeVertexBoneWeights
nodes.summary: Packs up to four bone indices/weights per vertex for GPU skinning.

nodes.name: FillBindPoseScratch
nodes.summary: Fills bind-pose bone matrices used to build the skin palette.

nodes.name: UpdateGpuSkinPalette
nodes.summary: Updates the 128-bone palette constant buffer from the current clip pose.

nodes.name: PublishSkinPalette
nodes.summary: Pushes the current skin palette to the shader.

nodes.name: UploadSkinnedVerticesIfDirty
nodes.summary: Uploads CPU-skinned vertices when GPU skinning is unavailable.

nodes.name: markVertexUploadDirty
nodes.summary: Flags CPU vertex data so the next draw uploads a new buffer.

nodes.name: GetAnimStackSpan
nodes.summary: Reads start time and duration from an FBX animation stack.

nodes.name: ScoreStackBoneMotion
nodes.summary: Scores an FBX anim stack by how much a sample bone moves, to pick the best clip.

nodes.name: BakeSkinningData
nodes.summary: Bakes bind pose, cluster weights, and palette layout after FBX import.

nodes.name: BakeRigidMeshData
nodes.summary: Prepares non-skinned mesh data when the FBX has no deformers.

nodes.name: InitAnimationInfo
nodes.summary: Initializes clip metadata after a successful FBX load.

nodes.name: LerpFbxAMatrix
nodes.summary: Linearly interpolates two FBX matrices for baked-clip sampling.

nodes.name: EnsureClipBaked
nodes.summary: Bakes a named animation clip into sampled bone matrices if not already cached.

nodes.name: SampleBakedClip
nodes.summary: Samples the baked clip at the current time into bone local matrices.

nodes.name: SkinFromScratch
nodes.summary: CPU-skins vertices from bind pose and the current bone palette.

nodes.name: UpdateAnimation
nodes.summary: Advances clip time and updates GPU or CPU skinning for this frame.

nodes.name: HasAnimation
nodes.summary: True when a named clip is available on this model.

nodes.name: MergeAnimScenesFrom
nodes.summary: Merges animation stacks from a shared source model into this instance.

nodes.name: EnsureAnimation
nodes.summary: Ensures a named clip is loaded, loading an external FBX if needed.

nodes.name: AddAnimation
nodes.summary: Loads an additional animation-only FBX and registers it under a clip name.

nodes.name: PlayAnimation
nodes.summary: Starts playback of a named clip, resetting time and loop state.

nodes.name: updateDynamicVBFromCP
nodes.summary: Uploads control-point positions into the dynamic vertex buffer.

nodes.name: uploadVertexBufferFromCPU
nodes.summary: Creates or updates the GPU vertex buffer from m_verticesCPU.

nodes.name: CreateAnimInstanceFrom
nodes.summary: Clones GPU buffers from a shared model and gives the instance its own animation state.

nodes.name: RenderSettings_ResetToDefaults
nodes.summary: Restores skybox, fog, shader, and shadow-quality fields to engine defaults.

nodes.name: RenderSettings_GetShadowPreset
nodes.summary: Returns map size, cascade count, and max distance for a shadow-quality enum.

nodes.name: RenderSettings_ShadowQualityFromId
nodes.summary: Parses a scene-JSON shadow-quality id string into the ShadowQuality enum.

nodes.name: RenderSettings_ApplyShadowQuality
nodes.summary: Reconfigures the Shadow system from the current quality preset and restores light direction.

nodes.name: RenderSettings_ApplyFromJson
nodes.summary: Applies a scene file's render object onto the live RenderSettingsData.

nodes.name: RenderSettings_ToJson
nodes.summary: Serializes live render settings for scene save.

nodes.name: RenderSettings_ReloadSkybox
nodes.summary: Reloads the skybox cubemap from the path stored in render settings.

nodes.name: RenderSettings_GetDefaultShader
nodes.summary: Maps the defaultShader id string to a Shader3DVariant.

nodes.name: ShadowQualityPreset
nodes.summary: Numeric shadow-map size, cascade count, and max distance for one quality tier.

nodes.name: RenderSettingsData
nodes.summary: Scene-wide skybox, clear color, default shader, fog, and shadow-quality settings.
